A '''Ubrikkian tail spiral ring''' was a piece of jewelry worn by wealthy Sleheyroni [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro]] the Hutt, who came from [[Sleheyron/Legends|Sleheyron]] was known to wear a spiral ring.
